scope: A dated discovery and compatibility snapshot, not a live version authority. Check each repository and release for newer evidence. The four releases recorded here were read from their GitHub Release pages, including each asset's published SHA-256.

coordination.work_tracking: The existing Linear WuwaTerm project remains authoritative for work tracking.

api.note: API v1 alone does not establish review-v2 or private Web auth-status capability.

manuscript.note: Interchange of saved manuscripts does not certify historical reports against the current dictionary.

terms_database.note: Build or obtain the terms database separately; it is not included in the products.

telegram_state.chat_settings: Unversioned JSON with public and allowed fields.
telegram_state.note: Follow Telegram's state and recovery instructions when moving or upgrading.

api_device_store.format: SQLite devices table, separate from the terms database
api_device_store.note: The observed implementation does not declare a numbered schema; preserve the device store and its SQLite state.

web_selfhost_admission.note: This stores aggregate admission counters, not manuscripts, and is separate from Core's databases.

products.responsibility: Shared dictionary, translation and review logic, HTTP API, data builder and validation, and common deployment and recovery tools.

release.manifest_note: The release manifest records source_commit, the runtime and builder image digests and the pinned upstream data revision: runtime sha256:199e36eb2266132af064e91f227c7c95e5bb5c5abb51f20830c98949028f46c1 and builder sha256:9cec5a5598d013bc1deefaa48697dc8b63122eda8878dcfd1d04b110c85b4ece, first pushed as sha-c5d9c46 and retagged by promote-images as v0.8.5 and 0.8.
release.note: v0.8.5 aligns delivery with a retired in-Core bot: the component-artifact verifier reads Docker v2 and OCI image archives, deploy/vps-update.sh re-creates a retired surface stopped instead of starting it, and deploy/setup.sh names the releases contracts/products.json records. No API shape, prompt, retry policy or data pin changed. v0.8.4 and its assets remain published under previous_release.

previous_release.note: Kept as history after v0.8.5; the release and its assets are still published. v0.8.3 and earlier remain on the release page.

candidate_source.note: The 0.7.0 source adds contextual term references and deploy/setup.sh. It was merged as 2ebb3259 and published as v0.7.0; the candidate wheel below belongs to an earlier candidate checkout and is not that source. Kept as history after the release.

candidate_wheel.note: A CI artifact of an earlier candidate checkout, recorded before the release; it is not the published 0.7.0 wheel.

products.adoption_note: Core 0.8.5 (c5d9c46, runtime image sha256:3a331149…) has been running in wuwaterm-api on the owner VPS since 2026-11-13, serving terms.db sha256 425f8679 with 11,987 terms, including all 655 Term<n>_Title pairs. The legacy in-Core wuwaterm-bot stayed stopped through vps-update.sh: it carries status=created and was never started. Telegram runs as the standalone 0.2.9 container, pinning the Core 0.8.5 wheel and reading the same terms.db copy.
products.transition: The observed Core source still contains the legacy Telegram and private Python Web adapters; retirement depends on usable successors.

products.responsibility: Standalone Telegram bot and its installation, operation and state.

release.note: v0.2.9 pins the published Core 0.8.5 wheel and verifies the Core bundle handoff in CI and in the release workflow. The API and review contracts are unchanged; production was updated.

compatibility.note: core-lock.json pins the published Core v0.8.5 wheel; release-to-release dependency, not a CI artifact.

previous_release.note: Kept as history after v0.2.9; the release and its assets are still published.

products.adoption_note: Standalone Telegram 0.2.9 on Core 0.8.5 was acquired with component_artifact.py acquire (acquisition_id 20261113T074317Z-4bc2f6e69196ff79ee8781172799edda, receipt sha256 e010c307…, image sha256:93d8a3a3…) and runs under Compose on the owner VPS with poll health ready and no Conflict in its container logs. The legacy in-Core wuwaterm-bot remains stopped and the API serves Core 0.8.5.

products.responsibility: Windows desktop client, local manuscript editing, packaging and independent release.

release.note: v0.4.2 fixes the empty-state card layout and the term-row tab order. No new service capability is required.

compatibility.note: Local manuscript editing works offline; online features require a configured API and device credential.

previous_release.note: Kept as history after v0.4.2; the release and its assets are still published.

products.adoption_note: 0.4.2 is published. 0.4.2 official ZIP (824b694c...) passed native Windows (qwindows) and offscreen --self-check on a 150%-DPI host; interactive human visual check, multi-monitor mixed-DPI drag, and live IME composition are not done.

products.responsibility: One browser workbench and same-origin backend for public and self-hosted use; Sites is a hosting target.

release.manifest_note: The published manifest records the archive under archive.name and the build prefix under base_path; the launcher, port and responses belong to the bundle (bundle/start.mjs, PORT defaults to 3000).
release.note: v0.2.0 supersedes v0.1.1; the earlier release and its recorded assets remain published under previous_release.

previous_release.manifest_note: The published manifest records the archive under archive.name and the build prefix under base_path; the launcher, port and responses belong to the bundle (bundle/start.mjs, PORT defaults to 3000).
previous_release.note: v0.1.1 superseded v0.1.0; both releases and their recorded assets are still published.

products.candidate_note: The two Actions artifacts from candidate_source were never releases; four recorded root/prefix smoke and Core replay commands exited 0. The published v0.1.0 assets were built later from 9f738e71, so their digests differ from these candidates and these archives are history, not release evidence.

publication_validation.note: Recorded while publication was still a read-only rehearsal; the write path was later exercised by the v0.1.0 release.

compatibility.selfhost_requires: A compatible Core API with GET /v1/auth/status and an issued device credential, plus an authenticated HTTPS reverse proxy that sets X-WuwaTerm-Edge.
compatibility.note: The Web BFF validates response shapes strictly; a matching API version alone does not prove compatibility.

products.adoption_note: The public Sites site runs saved version 30, deployed on 2026-11-13 from Web v0.2.0 (5aabe80bee3adda164e151de2da297a01860c301) with deployment status succeeded; a request to the root path https://wuwaterm.denia-official.chatgpt.site answered HTTP 200. Web main is that same commit, and v0.2.0 is the published Web product release.

ci_pins.note: These repository pins identify the specified contract-test inputs, not a guarantee for arbitrary version pairs.
